palette: ruled ledger cream + posting red + posting blue + record ink + brass rail accents
typography: ink headings with red edge tabs, ledger rows with red/blue posting chips for the two poles of every dichotomy, blue ruled lines kept faint, brass staples on card corners
composition: each scene is a ledger spread: the three elements read as a posting flow across columns, rule-vs-text opens a content/form ledger with four case entries, the three classifications hang as dichotomy rails with red-blue poles, omission reads as a matched verdict pair
surface: flat ledger cream with faint horizontal blue rules and a vertical red margin line, cream entry cards with hairline ink frames and brass corner staples, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: entries post left to right and stamp into place, red and blue poles land from opposite margins, the dichotomy rails rule themselves before their chips post, verdict pair closes like a ledger
transition: a page-turn shade wipes along the spine as the next spread opens
